blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型在连接视觉和语言方面取得了显著进展,促进了对人机互动、机器人和自主驾驶至关重要的各种感知任务。 然而,现有的基于 MLLM 的感知方法主要依赖于文本的坐标表示法,它受到过量的象征性间接费用,或者固定距离的量化,它受到范围和精确性的限制,特别是对于空间范围无限制和本地化精度要求高的3D域来说. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种名为DVD的动态矢量解码方法,它统一了2D和3D感知任务的表示. 具体地说,我们首先将不同的感官表示(即2D边框,2D口罩,3D边框)转换成1D向量序列,然后在高维空间将它们映射成紧凑的离散符号. 然后,一个轻量级的去tokenizer通过将输出符解码回原2D和3D的感知表示器,实现了与MLLM的无缝融合. 包括RefCOCO系列,SUN-RGBD,KITTI,Hypersim,nuScenes在内的2D和3D感知基准的广泛实验表明,DVD在2D和3D任务中实现了优异的性能,并显著降低了象征性间接费用和推论延迟性. DVD为将感知能力融入MLLM(英语:MLLM)提供了一个高效和一般的框架,克服了现有方法的固有局限性.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of MLLM perception paradigms. Existing methods either use text tokens (high token count, e.g., 512 tokens for masks) or special coordinate tokens (limited range and precision) to encode perception outputs. Our dynamic vector representation unifies diverse perception representations by converting them into 1D sequences and learning a unified codebook in high-dimensional space. This yields compact and high precision representations with fewer tokens, delivering consistent latency reduction across 2D and 3D tasks.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) Bai et al. (2023) ; Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Comanici et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2025) have achieved breakthroughs in bridging vision and language, enabling a wide range of perception tasks that are critical for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. Many previous works Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Lai et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2023) ; Pramanick et al. (2024) ; Fei et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2026) ; Liu et al. (2024a) ; Liu et al. (2025) ; Ren et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Wang et al. (2025a) integrate 2D or 3D perception capabilities into MLLMs to achieve more general perceptual understanding benefited from the powerful general understanding and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs, yet existing approaches still face fundamental limitations in representation and quantization that hinder their scalability and performance, especially in 3D domains.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs) Bai等人(2023);Bai等人(2025b); Bai等人(2025a); 王等 (2024a) ; 陈克. Yang等人(2025a); 陈等 (2024年); Comanici等 (2025年); Guo等 (2025年); Lu等 (2024年); Zhu等 (2025年) 在桥梁视觉和语言上取得了突破,使得对人机互动,机器人,自主驾驶至关重要的广泛认知任务得以实现. 许多前作是Bai等人(2025年b); Bai等 (2025a);Lai等 (2024);Yang等 (2023);Pramanick等 (2024);Fei等 (2024);Tang等 (2025);Jiang等 (2026);Liu等 (2024a);Liu等 (2025);Ren等 (2024);Zhang等 (2024b); Wang等 (2025a)将2D或3D感知能力整合到MLLMs中,以获得更普遍的认知理解,得益于MLLMs强大的一般理解和推理能力,而现有的方法在代表性和定量方面仍然面临根本性的限制,阻碍了它们的可伸缩性和性能,特别是在3D领域.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , current methods Bai et al. (2025a) ; Bai et al. (2025b) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Pramanick et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2026) for MLLM-based perception tasks predominantly rely on text-based representation of regression coordinates. Although these text-based methods can achieve unlimited range and high precision without a minimum quantization unit, they generate an excessive number of tokens, imposing substantial computational overhead in MLLMs. Moreover, these methods make the visual-language learning process more difficult, as the model must learn to identify the structure of floating-point numbers. To alleviate the learning difficulty of continuous coordinate values, a common solution Jiang et al. (2026) is to normalize these coordinates into a fixed integer range (e.g., 0 to 1000) and convert continuous spatial information into discrete special tokens that LLMs can process. Although this strategy suffers from two obvious limitations especially from 2D to 3D domains. The quantization of continuous coordinates into a fixed integer range encounters numerical range and precision constraints. In 2D scenes, the finite spatial scope of images partially alleviates these issues, but in 3D scenes, where spatial range is theoretically unbounded and requires precise localization of objects in 3D space Liu et al. (2024b) ; Hou et al. (2024) ; Brazil et al. (2023) . Due to the limitation of inference efficiency, fixed-range quantization either fails to capture the full spatial information of 3D environments or sacrifices precision due to the limitations of the minimum quantization unit, leading to these methods struggling to achieve full range and high precision of complex 3D scenarios. This raises the question: Can we achieve 2D and 3D perception representations with unlimited range and high precision using a small number of tokens?
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,目前的方法Bai等人(2025a); Bai等 (2025b); Guo等 (2025); Pramanick等 (2024); Tang等 (2025); Wang等 (2023). Huang等 (2025); Song等 (2026) 对于基于 MLLM 的感知任务,主要依靠文本代表回归坐标. 虽然这些以文字为基础的方法可以在没有最小的量化单位的情况下实现无限范围并高精度,但它们会产生过多的活字符号,在MLLMs中强制要求大量的计算间接费用. 此外,这些方法使得视觉语言的学习过程更加困难,因为模型必须学会识别浮点数的结构. 为了缓解连续坐标值的学习困难,一个共同的解决方案Jiang等 (2026)是将这些坐标正常化为固定整数范围(如0至1000),并将连续空间信息转换为LLM可以处理的离散特殊符号. 虽然这一战略有两个明显的局限性,特别是在2D到3D领域。 将连续坐标量化为固定整数范围会遇到数值范围和精度限制. 在2D场景中,图像的有限空间范围部分地缓解了这些问题,但在3D场景中,空间范围理论上没有被限制,需要在3D空间Liu等人(2024年b)中精确地定位物体; Hou等 (2024); 巴西等 (2023). 由于推论效率的限制,固定距离的量化要么无法捕捉到3D环境的全部空间信息,要么由于最小分量单位的局限性而牺牲精度,导致这些方法难以实现复杂3D情景的全程和高精度. 这引起了一个问题: 我们能使用少量的代币,以无限范围和高精度实现2D和3D感知表示吗?

blocks.en:
To address these fundamental limitations, we draw inspiration from Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders (VQ-VAE) Kingma and Welling (2013) ; Van Den Oord et al. (2017) , a framework that has proven effective in learning compact and discrete representations of continuous data by mapping inputs to a learnable codebook of limited discrete tokens. We argue that compact representations of low-dimensional spaces can be achieved in high-dimensional spaces. Building on this insight, we propose dynamic vector decoding (DVD) for MLLMs that can seamlessly unify the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks, effectively overcoming the token inefficiency of text-based coordinate representation and the range and precision constraints of fixed-range quantization. In this paper, our core innovation lies in transforming diverse perception representations (2D boxes, 2D masks, and 3D boxes) into a 1D vector sequence and projecting the sequence into discrete tokens in high-dimensional space, reducing learning difficulty and inference cost for both 2D and 3D tasks.
Although some previous works Wu et al. (2026) ; Team (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2023) have explored the integration of VQ-VAE Van Den Oord et al. (2017) into MLLMs, we are the first to introduce a unified high-dimensional codebook for MLLM-based perception, unifying heterogeneous 2D and 3D perceptual representations in high-dimensional space. We also introduce geometric loss to enable the unified codebook to faithfully capture the geometric structures of heterogeneous perception tasks.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些根本的局限性,我们从矢量量化的变相自动编码器(VQ-VAE)Kingma和Welling(2013年);Van Den Oord等人(2017年),这个框架已证明是有效的,它通过对有限离散符号的可学习编码本进行绘图,在学习紧凑和离散的连续数据表述方面行之有效。 我们主张,低维空间的紧凑表现可以在高维空间实现. 基于这种洞察力,我们提出MLLMs的动态向量解码(DVD),可以无缝地将2D和3D感知任务的表示统一起来,有效克服了以文字为基础的坐标表示的象征性效率低下,以及固定距离分数的范畴和精度限制. 在本文中,我们的核心创新在于将不同的感官表示(2D盒,2D口罩,和3D盒)转换为1D向量序列,并将序列投射为高维空间的离散符号,降低2D和3D任务的学习难度和推论成本.
虽然以前的一些作品 Wu等 (2026); Team (2024); Jiang等 (2023) 探索将VQ-VAE Van Den Oord等 (2017)整合入MLLMs,我们是第一个引入基于MLLLM感知的统一的高维码典,统一了高维空间的异相2D和3D感知表示. 我们还引入了几何损失,使统一编码本能够忠实地捕捉各种感知任务的几何结构.

blocks.en: Moreover, to learn meaningful discrete representations of these 1D sequences, we design a 1D encoder-decoder architecture, which supports joint training for multiple perception tasks in a unified manner. During training, the encoder maps the 1D vector sequences to a latent space, and the decoder reconstructs the original 1D sequences from this latent representation. Through this process, we learn a unified codebook that maps continuous 1D vector sequences into compact, discrete tokens. This codebook not only enables spatial representation of adaptive quantization for 2D and 3D tasks without fixed range constraints, but also provides inherent compression capabilities, significantly reducing the computational overhead of MLLMs compared to text-based coordinate representation methods. Moreover, a key advantage of our framework is its seamless integration with MLLMs in the decoding process. Because we only need an additional de-tokenizer to decode the tokens belonging to the perception task from the MLLMs output tokens back to their original 2D and 3D representations.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了学习这些1D序列的有意义的离散表示,我们设计出一个1D编码器-解码器架构,它支持以统一的方式对多个认知任务进行联合培训. 在训练期间,编码器将 1D 向量序列映射到潜伏空间,解码器从这种潜伏的表示中重建出原始的 1D 序列. 通过这个过程,我们学习了一个统一的编码本,将连续的一维向量序列映射成紧凑的,离散的符号. 这个编码本不仅能够在没有固定范围限制的情况下,对2D和3D任务进行适应性量化的空间表示,还提供了内在的压缩能力,相较于基于文本的坐标表示方法,MLLMs的计算管理费大幅降低. 此外,我们框架的一个主要优势是它在解码过程中与MLLMs的无缝结合。 因为我们只需要一个额外的去tokenizer来解码属于感知任务的代号,从MLLM输出代号返回到原来的2D和3D表示.

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness and generality of our proposed method we conduct extensive experiments across 2D and 3D benchmarks for 2D grounding, referring expression segmentation (RES) and 3D grounding tasks. For 3D grounding, we evaluate our method on four widely used datasets: SUN-RGBD Song et al. (2015) , KITTI Geiger et al. (2012) , Hypersim Roberts et al. (2021) , and nuScenes Caesar et al. (2020) , covering diverse indoor and outdoor 3D scenarios. For 2D grounding and RES, we validate our method on the RefCOCO Lin et al. (2014) , RefCOCO+ Lin et al. (2014) , and RefCOCOg Mao et al. (2016) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of 3D and 2D grounding accuracy, while maintaining competitive performance in 2D referring segmentation and achieving significant reductions in token overhead and inference latency, demonstrating its superiority in both performance and efficiency within a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们拟议方法的有效性和通性,我们在2D地面基准和3D地面基准方面进行了广泛的试验,并提及表达分解(RES)和3D地面任务。 就三维定位而言,我们对四个广泛使用的数据集进行评估: 太阳-RGBD Song等 (2015年),KITTI Geiger等 (2012年),Hypersim Roberts等 (2021年),和nuScenes Caesar等 (2020年),涵盖了多种室内外3D情景. 关于2D定位和RES,我们验证了我们的方法,即RefCOCO Lin等人(2014年)、RefCO+ Lin等人(2014年)和RefCOCOg Mao等人。 (2016)数据集. 实验结果表明,我们的方法在3D和2D定位精度方面超过了现有的先进方法,同时在2D中保持竞争性的分层性能,并显著降低象征性的间接费用和推断延迟性,表明它在统一框架内的性能和效率方面都具有优势。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions are summarized as: • We propose a dynamic vector decoding (DVD) that converts 3D boxes, 2D boxes, and 2D masks into 1D vector sequences and learn a unified codebook by projecting these 1D sequences into the high-dimensional space. The proposed method can significantly improve the inference efficiency and provide inherent compression capability. • To enable the unified codebook to faithfully capture the geometric structures of heterogeneous perception tasks, we introduce a task-agnostic geometric loss, which supervises the decoded representations in terms of geometry rather than sequence parameterization and provides unified geometric supervision for both 2D and 3D tasks. • We validate our method on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance across 3D grounding task, 2D grounding task, and 2D referring segmentation, while significantly reducing token overhead and inference latency.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们的贡献概括为: 我们提出动态向量解码(DVD),将3D盒,2D盒,2D口罩转换为1D向量序列,并通过将这些1D序列投影到高维空间来学习统一编码本. 拟议方法可大大提高推论效率并提供固有的压缩能力。 为了使统一的编码本能够忠实地捕捉到不同感知任务的几何结构,我们引入了任务不可知几何损失,它从几何学角度而不是序列参数化的角度来监督解码的表示,并为2D和3D两个任务提供统一的几何监督. ^ 我们在2D和3D感知基准上验证我们的方法,在3D地基任务,2D地基任务,和2D参考分块任务中表现出优异的性能,同时能显著地减少象征性间接费用和推论性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: With the rapid development of LLMs in NLP field, MLLMs have become an indispensable part of LLM research, enabling more general intelligent perception and reasoning with the rich visual information. Early MLLMs Bai et al. (2023) ; Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Team et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Team et al. (2024) ; Comanici et al. (2025) adopt a paradigm of combining vision encoders with pre-trained LLMs via projectors with image-text alignment training. Recent works Wang et al. (2024b) ; Yang et al. (2025b) ; Diao et al. (2024) have focused on building native MLLMs to unleash stronger general multimodal capabilities. Meanwhile, more and more models such as Qwen3-VL Bai et al. (2025a) and SEED1.5-VL Guo et al. (2025) continuously expand the capabilities of MLLMs by introducing co-training on a large number of different tasks (e.g., Coding, Agent, and Perception), thereby enhancing the versatility of MLLMs. Despite these advancements, most existing MLLMs still face the challenge of how to fully unleash the potential of MLLMs for diverse perception tasks.
blocks.zh: 随着LLMs在NLP领域的快速发展,MLLMs成为了LLM研究不可或缺的一环,使得能用丰富的视觉信息进行更普遍的智能感知和推理. 早期的MLLMs Bai等人(2023);Bai等人(2025b); Bai等人(2025a); 王等 (2024a) ; 陈克. 杨等 (2025a); 郭等 (2025); Team等 (2026). 陈等 (2024年); 朱等 (2025年); 王等 (2025年b; ). Team等人(2024年);Comanici等人(2025年)采用了一种范例,即通过投影仪将视觉编码器与经过预先培训的LLMS结合,并进行图像文本校正培训. 近代著作"王等"(2024年b); 杨等 (2025b; ; ). Diao等人(2024年)着重建设本土的MLLMs,以释放出更强大的一般多模式能力. 同时,越来越多的模式,如Qune3-VL Bai等(2025a)和SEED1.5-VL Guo等(2025),通过对大量不同的任务(如编码,Agent,和Perception)进行联合培训,不断扩大MLLM的能力,从而增强MLLM的多功能. 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有的 mLLM仍然面临着如何充分释放 mLLM 的潜力以完成多种认知任务的挑战.

blocks.en: For MLLM-based perception, existing works can mainly be divided into two paradigms. Some works Lai et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2023) ; Pramanick et al. (2024) ; Fei et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Pi et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2026) focus on utilizing additional task-specific decoders. These methods retain the pre-trained MLLM backbone and introduce decoders tailored to specific perceptual tasks (e.g., 2D mask decoding, 3D box regression), leveraging the MLLM’s strong semantic reasoning ability to guide the decoder in generating perceptual outputs. Other works Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Fu et al. (2025) ; Jiang et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2025c) ; Liu et al. (2024a) ; Team et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2025c) directly convert all perception tasks into text format. These methods adopt language to describe perceptual prediction (such as 2D/3D coordinate values), allowing the MLLM to process perception tasks in a unified text-generation manner without additional decoders. However, both paradigms have limitations: task-specific decoders lack generality and cannot simultaneously handle different perception tasks, while text-format methods suffer from the inefficiency of text-based coordinate representation that are more obvious in 3D scenes where spatial dimensions are unbounded and precision requirements are higher.
blocks.zh: 对于基于MLLM的感知,现有的作品主要可以被分为两个范式. 一些著作有:Lai等 (2024年);Yang等 (2023年);Pramanick等 (2024年);Fei等 (2024年);Zhang等 (2024年b; 张等 (2024a); 皮等 (2024); 陈等 (2023); 刘等. (2026)侧重于使用额外的特定任务解码器. 这些方法保留了预先训练的MLLM主干线,并引入了适合特定知觉任务的解码器(如2D口罩解码,3D盒回放),利用了MLLM强大的语义推理能力来引导解码器生成知觉输出. 其他著作Bai等人(2025年b); Bai等人(2025a); Tang等人(2025年);Fu等人(2025年); 蒋等 (2026); 杨等 (2025c); 刘等 (2024a); 杨等 (2024a); 杨等 (2025c). Team等 (2026); Yang等 (2025c) 直接将所有感知任务转换为文本格式. 这些方法采用了语言来描述知觉预测(如2D/3D坐标值),使MLLM能够以统一的文本生成方式处理知觉任务而无需额外的解码器. 然而,两种范式都有局限性:任务特定的解码器缺乏通俗性并无法同时处理不同的感知任务,而文本格式方法则受到基于文本的坐标代表效率低下的影响,在空间维度无限制和精度要求更高的3D场景中,这种效率更为明显.

blocks.en: Designing perceptual representation is critical for the performance and efficiency of MLLM-based perception tasks. Most existing methods Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) rely on text-based representation of regression coordinates. These methods face the difficulty of learning continuous coordinates and need a lot of tokens to process coordinates. To mitigate the difficulty of learning continuous coordinates, some methods normalize coordinates into a fixed integer range (e.g., 0 to 1000) and convert them into discrete textual tokens. For instance, Rex-Omni Jiang et al. (2026) propose next-point prediction for different 2D grounding tasks by introducing special tokens for quantized coordinates (0 to 999) in the LLM vocabulary. However, due to the boundless nature of 3D space, this method is not suitable for complex 3D scenes. Additionally, fixed-range quantization has inherent precision constraints, which are more important for accurate localization in 3D scenes.

blocks.en: To address these problems, we propose a dynamic decoding method that unifies 2D and 3D perceptual representations into 1D vector sequences. Our method effectively overcomes limitations of existing methods by learning a unified codebook for adaptive compression and quantization.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提出一种能动的解码方法,将2D和3D的知觉表示统一为1D向量序列. 我们的方法有效地克服了现有方法的局限性,通过学习一个适应性压缩和量化的统一代码本.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a simple and effective MLLM-based perception framework named dynamic vector decoding (DVD), which can
unify the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks and seamlessly integrate into current MLLMs. Specifically, we first convert 2D and 3D perceptual representation into 1D vector sequence. Then we design a 1D encoder-decoder architecture that adaptively maps these different sequences into latent space and generates corresponding discrete tokens by learning unified limited codebook with reconstruction of multiple perception tasks. In the inference, we only need an additional detokenizer to decode the decode the tokens belonging to the perception task from the MLLMs output tokens back to their original 2D/3D representations.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了一个简单而有效的基于 MLLM 的感知框架,命名为动态向量解码(DVD),可以
将 2D 和 3D 感知任务的表示统一,并无缝地整合到当前 MLLM. 具体来说,我们首先将2D和3D的知觉代表转换为1D向量序列. 然后我们设计出一个1D编码器-解码器架构来适应地将这些不同的序列映射到潜伏的空间中,并通过学习统一的受限代码并重建多个感知任务来生成相应的离散符号. 推论中,我们只需要一个额外的解码器来解码属于感知任务的指使从MLLM输出指使回回原2D/3D表示.

blocks.en: 3.2 Perceptual Representation
blocks.zh: 3.2 观念代表性

blocks.en: To unify the input format of diverse 2D and 3D perception tasks, we convert all perceptual representation including 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes into 1D vector sequences. For 2D boxes, we select left-top and right-down corner points and flatten them ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}) . For 2D masks, we sample fixed points ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 , … , x N , y N ) (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2},...,x_{N},y_{N}) uniformly along the edge of the mask, starting from the top left point in the clockwise direction. We further normalize these points by the width and height of the input image, ensuring that the vector sequence is invariant to image resolution. For 3D boxes, we use the standard structures of 3D boxes ( x , y , z , w , h , l , R ) (x,y,z,w,h,l,R) , where ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) is the 3D center, w , h , l w,h,l is the scale, and R ∈ ℝ 3 × 3 R\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times 3} is the rotation matrix of the 3D box, respectively. Due to the unbounded nature of 3D scenes, we directly use the original numerical values to ensure the precise localization.

blocks.en: 3.3 Dynamic Vector Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 动态病媒代表性学习

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , the unified vector autoencoder converts 1D vectors to discrete tokens, consisting of a 1D encoder, a learnable codebook, and a 1D decoder. We train the autoencoder end-to-end with reconstruction and multiple perception tasks. Specifically, given the input vector sequences 𝐬 ∈ ℝ B × L × 1 \mathbf{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times L\times 1} . For sequences whose length is not divisible by 2, we pad the end of the sequence with zeros. Then we encode input vector sequences into latent space by the 1D encoder, generating latent vectors 𝐳 ∈ ℝ B × L K × C \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times\frac{L}{K}\times C} , where K K and C C are the downsampling factor and feature dimension of vectors, respectively. Next, we compute euclidean distances between flattened 𝐳 \mathbf{z} and embedding vectors to select the closest quantized latent vectors. The symmetric 1D decoder upsamples quantized latent vectors to reconstruct the original 1D sequence. By learning the data distribution after converting the data into a 1D sequence, the vector autoencoder possesses the ability to adapt to different 2D and 3D perception tasks without task-specific modifications. The unified codebook learned from multiple tasks enables the autoencoder to handle variable-length vector sequences from different tasks.

blocks.en: Beyond the standard reconstruction and VQ losses, our unified vector autoencoder requires geometric constraints to faithfully recover the original perceptual representations. This is because the L1 reconstruction loss only measures per-dimension numerical differences of the flattened sequence, which is sensitive to point ordering and parameterization rather than the underlying geometry: two sequences encoding identical shapes with different starting points incur a large penalty, while geometrically distorted outputs may only yield small errors. Meanwhile, the VQ loss constrains the embeddings only in the latent space, providing no guarantee that the decoded outputs preserve geometric structures (e.g., corners, edges, and shapes) in the original representation space. To address these limitations, we introduce a geometric loss based on the bidirectional chamfer distance, which is permutation-invariant and task-agnostic, thus providing a unified geometric supervision for both 2D and 3D perception tasks.

blocks.en: 3.4 Dynamic Vector Decoding
blocks.zh: 3.4 动态矢量解码

blocks.en: To integrate the unified vector autoencoder with MLLMs, we first extend the vocabulary of the MLLM by adding M M new tokens, corresponding to the M M code vectors in the codebook. During the training of the MLLM with our autoencoder, we use the standard training paradigm as the same as MLLMs. This integration is lightweight and does not require modifying the MLLM backbone, ensuring compatibility with various pre-trained MLLMs. In the inference, we use the decoder of our vector autoencoder as the de-tokenizer for converting the discrete tokens output by the MLLM back into the 1D vector sequence, which is then converted into the original 2D/3D perceptual representation. Specifically, we first use the de-tokenizer to map each discrete token belonging to perception tasks output by the MLLM to its corresponding code vector in the pre-trained codebook. Then the de-tokenizer uses the pre-trained 1D decoder to reconstruct the 1D vector sequence from the code vector. Notably, the dynamic vector decoding process introduces minimal computational overhead compared to text-based methods. Since each perceptual representation is mapped to a small number of discrete tokens and the sequence length fed into the MLLM is significantly reduced, improving inference efficiency. Additionally, the de-tokenizer is a lightweight module (reusing the pre-trained decoder), avoiding the need for complex task-specific decoders and maintaining the generality of the framework.
blocks.zh: 要将统一的矢量自编码器与MLLMs相融合,我们首先通过添加MM新符来扩展MLLM的词汇,与代码簿中的MM代码向量相对应. 在使用自编码器进行MLLM训练期间,我们使用标准训练范式与MLLMs相同. 这种集成是轻量级的,不需要修改MLLM主干线,确保与各种被预训的MLLM相兼容. 推论中,我们使用我们矢量自编码器的解码器作为去tokenizer,将MLLM输出的离散活性符号回转为1D向量序列,再转换为原2D/3D能感能表示. 具体地说,我们首先使用去tokenizer将MLLM输出的每个属于感知任务的离散符号映射到其预先训练的代码簿中相应的代码向量. 然后去切除器使用被预先训练的1D解码器从代码向量中重建出1D向量序列. 值得注意的是,与基于文本的方法相比,动态矢量解码程序引入了最低限度的计算间接费用。 由于每个能见度的表示被映射到少量的离散符号上,输入MLLM的序列长度被大幅降低,从而提高了推论效率. 此外,去除调试器是一个轻量级模块(重新使用被预先训练的调试器),避免了复杂任务特定解码器的需要并保持了框架的通俗性.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: For 3D grounding, we use four benchmarks covering indoor and outdoor scenarios: SUN-RGBD Song et al. (2015) , Hypersim Roberts et al. (2021) , KITTI Geiger et al. (2012) , and nuScenes Caesar et al. (2020) . SUN-RGBD Song et al. (2015) is a 3D indoor dataset with RGB-D images and 3D bounding box annotations. Hypersim Roberts et al. (2021) is a photorealistic synthetic indoor dataset, providing 3D bounding boxes and semantic labels for generalization validation. KITTI Geiger et al. (2012) is an outdoor autonomous driving dataset, annotated with 3D bounding boxes for traffic objects. nuScenes Caesar et al. (2020) is a comprehensive outdoor benchmark with 1000 scenes and high-precision 3D bounding boxes. For 2D grounding and referring segmentation tasks, we use RefCOCO Lin et al. blocks.en: The quality of 1D vector reconstruction directly affects the performance of subsequent perception tasks. Therefore, we evaluate the reconstruction performance of our unified vector autoencoder by using perception metrics between the ground truth and the decoded sequences from the quantized tokens. Our autoencoder achieves negligible reconstruction error (90.8% AP3D, 100.0% Precision, and 84.8% cIoU for 3D grounding, 2D grounding, and 2D RES task), demonstrating its ability to preserve spatial information.

blocks.en: In this section, we adopt ablation study to illustrate the effectiveness of our method. For convenience, we train our model with 30% of the full training iterations for faster validation, and all ablation experiments are conducted on the DVD-2B. More ablations and visualization results are illustrated in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们通过研究,说明我们的方法的有效性。 为了方便,我们用30%的完整训练迭代来训练我们的模型,以更快的验证,所有的衰竭实验都在DVD-2B上进行. 附录中说明了更多的编织和可视化结果。

blocks.en: To demonstrate the efficiency of DVD, we compare the average number of tokens generated for per object, latency, and performance of different representations in Figure 4 , using identical training settings and computation resources for a fair comparison. For the special token representation, we follow the coordinate tokenization of Rex-Omni Jiang et al. (2026) and extend the vocabulary with 4000 special tokens shared across all coordinates: 2D box and mask coordinates are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by image size, while 3D centers, sizes, and rotation entries are scaled into [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] and linearly mapped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , then uniformly quantized into 4000 bins.
blocks.zh: 为了展示DVD的效率,我们利用相同的培训设置和计算资源来进行公平比较,比较图4中每个对象生成的平均信使数量、时间和不同表现的性能。 对于特殊符号表示,我们遵循Rex-Omni Jiang等的坐标符号化(2026年),并用所有坐标共享的4000个特殊符号来扩展词汇:2D框和口罩坐标按图像大小归正为 [0, 1] [0, 1];而3D中心,大小,和旋转条目被缩放为 [− 1, 1] [1, 1] 并线性地被绘制为 [0, 1] [0, 1],然后统一地被分解为 400 00 bins.

We report the average tokens generated per object and the inference latency on SUN-RGBD Song et al. (2015) and RefCOCOg Kazemzadeh et al. (2014) .
Text-based coordinates generate excessive tokens (512 and 74 for mask and 3D box), incurring high latency. Since text preserves the raw coordinate values with unlimited range and precision, it retains a slight accuracy advantage on 3D grounding 37.5% vs. 34.1% AP3D). However, this marginal gain comes with 9 × \times more tokens and 8.3 × \times higher latency (4165 ms vs. 499 ms per object). Special tokens reduce the cost but suffer severe degradation (17.5% AP3D) due to limited range and precision. In contrast, DVD matches text-level precision on 2D tasks, largely closes the 3D gap, and achieves significant 3D gains the special-token representation, delivering the best accuracy efficiency trade-off.

blocks.en: Codebook Size. Table 6 illustrates the effect of the codebook size. A small codebook (2048) limits the representational capacity of the discrete latent space, failing to cover diverse geometric patterns (88.9% AP3D and 84.5% Precision). On the other hand, an overly large codebook (8192) increases the difficulty of quantization and codebook learning, leading to under-trained entries and degraded reconstruction (85.1% AP3D and 76.8% cIoU). The codebook size of 4096 achieves the best performance across all three tasks and is thus adopted as our default setting.
blocks.zh: 代码簿大小. 表6说明了密码簿尺寸的影响。 一个小的密码本(2048)限制了离散潜入空间的能见度,未能覆盖出不同的几何图案(88.9%的AP3D和84.5%的精度). 另一方面,过于庞大的代码本(8192)增加了量化和代码本学习的难度,导致条目培训不足并退化重建(85.1%的AP3D和76.8%的cIoU). 4096的编码本尺寸实现了所有三项任务的最佳性能,因此被采用为我们的默认设置.

blocks.en: Geometric Loss. Table 6 validates the effect of the geometric loss. Incorporating geometric guidance consistently improves the reconstruction performance across all tasks, with particularly notable gains on 3D grounding (+10.1% AP3D) and 2D RES (+10.0% cIoU). This indicates that geometric supervision plays a critical role when fine-grained spatial fidelity is required. For example, depth estimation in 3D scenes and boundary delineation in segmentation are both highly sensitive to small coordinate deviations. Therefore, the vanilla reconstruction objective alone fails to penalize. In contrast, the improvement on 2D grounding is relatively marginal (+0.9% Precision), since coarse box localization in 2D images is less sensitive to minor geometric errors and its performance is already near saturation. These observations confirm that the geometric loss is not merely a regularizer but an essential component for learning a unified vector representation. By explicitly constraining the decoded vectors to preserve the underlying spatial structure, it enables a single codebook to serve both 2D and 3D box-based grounding and mask-based segmentation without task-specific designs.
blocks.zh: 几何损失. 表6验证了几何损失的影响. 纳入几何指导能够持续地改善所有任务的重建业绩,在3D地面(+10.1% AP3D)和2D RES(+1.0.0% cIoU)上特别显著的收获. 这表明,在需要精细的空间忠诚时,几何监督起着关键作用。 例如,三维场景中的深度估计和分界的边界划分,对小坐标偏差都高度敏感. 因此,仅凭香草重建目标不能惩罚。 相形之下,2D地平面的改进相对来说是边际的(+0.9%精度),因为2D图像中粗糙的盒子定位对小几何误差不太敏感,其性能已经接近饱和. 这些观察证实,几何损失不仅是常态化器,而且是学习统一的矢量表示的基本组成部分. 它通过明确限制被解码的向量以维护基础空间结构,使得一个单一的代码簿既能服务于2D和3D的箱基地平面,又能服务于基于面具的分割而无需任务特定的设计.

blocks.en: We further investigate the effect of different settings of the DVD autoencoder on the vector reconstruction performance, including the downsampling scale K K , latent hidden size z z , and multi-task learning in the vector representation learning.

blocks.en: Downsampling Scale. As shown in Table 8 , we ablate the effect of the downsampling scale K K . Compared with the uncompressed representation ( K = 1 K{=}1 ), setting K = 2 K{=}2 reduces the token count by half while maintaining competitive performance (90.8% AP3D and 100.0% Precision for 3D and 2D grounding, respectively), and even slightly improves the 3D grounding accuracy. However, an excessively large scale ( K = 4 K{=}4 ) leads to severe information loss during compression, resulting in significant performance degradation, especially on the 2D grounding task (31.5% Precision). These results demonstrate that K = 2 K{=}2 achieves the best trade-off between reconstruction precision and token cost, verifying that our learned codebook retains spatial semantics while reducing sequence length.
blocks.zh: 下采样尺度。 如表8所示,我们减缓了下取样比例KK的影响。 相较于未压缩的表示(K = 1 K{=}1),设置K = 2 K{=}2在保持竞争性性能的同时将符数减半(AP3D为90.8%,而3D和2D地平分的精度为100.0%),甚至略微提高3D地平分精度. 然而,规模过大(K = 4 K{=}4)导致压缩过程中信息严重丢失,导致性能严重退化,特别是在2D地基任务上(31.5%精度). 这些结果表明,K = 2 K{=}2在重建精度和符号成本之间实现了最好的取舍,验证了我们所学的代码本保留了空间语义,同时缩短了序列长度.

blocks.en: Latent Hidden Size. As shown in Table 8 , we ablate the latent hidden size z z . A narrow latent bottleneck ( z = 8 z{=}8 ) constrains the encoded spatial information, causing a notable drop on the 3D grounding task (83.0% AP3D). In contrast, enlarging z z to 32 brings no consistent gains and even slightly degrades the 3D reconstruction quality (88.4% AP3D), as a higher-dimensional latent space is harder to quantize effectively. Setting z = 16 z{=}16 provides sufficient capacity with stable quantization, achieving the best overall performance.
blocks.zh: 下层隐藏大小 。 如表8所示,我们减少潜在的隐藏大小 z z 。 一个狭义的潜在瓶颈(z = 8 z{=}8)会约束被编码的空间信息,导致3D搁浅任务(83.0% AP3D)的显著下降. 相比之下,将z扩大至32不会带来一致的收益,甚至会略微地降低3D重建质量(88.4% AP3D),因为高维潜在空间更难被有效量化. seting z = 16 z {=}16 提供了足够的能力并稳定地量化,实现了最佳的整体性能.

blocks.en: Multi-task Training in DVD. Our proposed DVD supports 2D and 3D perception tasks with unified 1D vector representation. We validate the effect of multi-task training by comparing the performance of the autoencoder trained on single task and multi-task training in Table 9 . Experimental results show that joint multi-task training improve performance on both 3D grounding task and 2D RES task. Moreover, the performance of 2D grounding remains stable without obvious degradation. These results demonstrate the learning capability for dynamic vector representation of our method without sacrificing the performance of individual tasks.
blocks.zh: DVD多任务训练. 我们拟议的DVD支持2D和3D的感知任务,具有统一的1D向量表示. 我们通过比较表9关于单一任务和多任务培训的自动编码器的性能来验证多任务培训的效果。 实验结果表明,联合多任务培训提高了3D地面任务和2D RES任务的业绩。 此外,2D地基的性能仍然稳定,没有明显的退化. 这些结果表明,在不牺牲个别任务执行的情况下,我们的方法具有动态矢量表现的学习能力。

blocks.en: 4.5 Visualization.

We provide qualitative visualization results to illustrate the perception capability of DVD. As shown in Figure 5 , we visualize the qualitative results of DVD on the 3D grounding, 2D grounding, and 2D RES tasks. As shown in the first row, DVD can achieve satisfactory results even in dark and complex 3D scenes. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Existing MLLM-based perception methods struggle with excessive token overhead from text-based coordinate representation and precision and range constraints from fixed-range quantization, especially in 3D domains. To address the key limitation, we propose DVD that unifies 2D and 3D perception task representations for efficient integration with MLLMs. By transforming heterogeneous perceptual outputs into 1D vector sequences and mapping them to compact discrete tokens, DVD eliminates the excessive token overhead and the precision limitations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D benchmarks show that DVD achieves superior performance while significantly reducing token count and inference latency, offering an efficient and general framework for equipping MLLMs with perception capabilities.
blocks.zh: 现有的基于MLLM的感知方法与基于文本的坐标表示和精确度以及固定范围量化(特别是在3D领域)范围限制的过度象征性间接费用相冲突。 为了解决关键限制,我们提议使用统一2D和3D感知任务表达的DVD来高效地与MLLM集成. DVD通过将各种感官输出转换为1D向量序列并将其映射到紧凑的离散符号上,消除了过量的符号间接费用和精度限制. 对2D和3D基准的广泛实验表明,DVD在显著地减少信使计数和推断延迟的同时取得了优异的性能,为为MLLMs配备感知能力提供了一个高效而通用的框架.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en: In this section, we provide the architecture details of our unified autoencoder. The 1D encoder is designed with a multi-stage downsampling architecture, stacked with 1D resnet blocks and 1D attention blocks. It takes 1D vector sequences as input, and extracts feature representations through successive layers and downsampling operations. A 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional layer is appended to the encoder output to project the latent features into the embedding dimension of the codebook.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提供了我们统一自动编码器的架构细节. 1D编码器采用多相下采样架构设计,堆放有1D回网块和1D注意力块. 它需要1D向量序列作为输入,通过相接的地层和下采样操作来提取特征表示. 编码器输出后附加了1×1 1\times 1等分层来将潜在的特性投射入编码本的嵌入维.

blocks.en:
The vector quantization module adopts the VectorQuantizer Van Den Oord et al. (2017) , which maintains a fixed-size learnable discrete codebook. This module computes the Euclidean distance between the projected latent features and each codebook embedding, assigns each feature to the nearest codebook entry, and adopts straight-through gradient estimation to ensure gradient consistency. The codebook serves as the core of the unified representation, mapping continuous 1D vector sequences into compact discrete tokens that can be efficiently processed by MLLMs.
Symmetric to the encoder, the 1D decoder adopts a multi-stage upsampling architecture, also composed of 1D resnet blocks and 1D attention blocks. A 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional layer is placed at the decoder input to project the quantized discrete tokens back to the latent dimension. The decoder then reconstructs the original 1D vector sequences from the quantized tokens through successive layers and upsampling operations. The latent dimension and codebook is set to 16 and 4096, respectively.

矢量分量模块采用矢量分量器Van Den Oord等(2017年),该分量模块维持有固定大小可学习的离散代码本. 本模块计算了预测的潜在特性与每个编码本嵌入之间的欧几利得相距,将每个特性指派到最近的编码本条目,并采用直通梯度估计,以确保梯度一致性. 代码本作为统一表示的核心,将连续的一维向量序列映射为可被MLLMs高效处理的紧凑的离散符号.
与编码器对称,1D解码器采用多相上下取样架构,也由1D回网块和1D注意力块组成. 1×1 1\times 1 分解层被放入解码器输入来投放被分解的离散符号回回潜维. 解码器再通过相接的地层和上取样操作,从被分解的地标上重建出原来的1D向量序列. 潜在维度和编码本分别被设定为16和4096.

To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness, generality, and robustness of DVD across 2D and 3D perception tasks, we conduct experiments on a diverse set of benchmark datasets covering indoor and outdoor scenes. These datasets are carefully curated from existing public datasets, covering the core scenarios of 3D grounding, 2D grounding, and 2D RES. Detailed statistics of the datasets are summarized in Table 10 . For 3D grounding, we select six representative datasets to cover both indoor and outdoor 3D scenarios. SUN-RGBD Song et al. (2020) are outdoor autonomous driving datasets with complex traffic scenes and dynamic objects. These datasets provide 489K 3D grounding QAs.
For 2D grounding, we combine two types of datasets: three standard 2D referring datasets (RefCOCO Lin et al. (2014) , RefCOCO+ Lin et al. (2014) , RefCOCOg Mao et al. (2016) ) with rich instructions and diverse 2D scenes, and the 2D projections of the six 3D datasets mentioned above. This combination ensures a total of 810K 2D grounding QAs, allowing DVD to achieve better generalization across 2D and 3D scenarios.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Works
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来工程

blocks.en: F.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: F.1 限制

blocks.en: Despite the advantages of our Dynamic Vector Decoding (DVD) framework in unifying 2D and 3D perception for MLLMs, it has some limitations. The reconstruction performance of our dynamic vector representation learning can still be improved to achieve better performance even with a larger downsampling factor. Moreover, the DVD de-tokenizer for codebook learning, while effective, is designed as a separate component from the MLLM. This decoupling may lead to suboptimal alignment between the learned discrete tokens and the semantic understanding of MLLM.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的动态矢量解码(DVD)框架在将MLLM的2D和3D感知统一起来方面有其优点,但它还是有一些局限性. 我们动态矢量表现学习的重建业绩仍可改进,以取得更好的业绩,即使有更大的下取样因素。 此外,用于密码本学习的DVD解调器虽然有效,但被设计为与MLLM独立的组件. 这种脱钩可能导致所学的离散符号和对MLLM的语义理解之间的不优化对接.

blocks.en: F.2 Future Works
blocks.zh: F.2 未来工程

blocks.en: Our method can support more representations of more perception tasks. Future work will further optimize the dynamic vector representation learning process, extend the codebook to diverse tasks, and explore end-to-end training of the encoder-decoder and MLLM.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法可以支持更多表达更多的感知任务. 未来工作将进一步优化动态向量表示学习过程,将代码手册扩展至多种任务,并探索对编码器-解码器和MLLM的端到端培训.

blocks.en: Appendix G Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录G 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Our DVD framework provides a new generalizable paradigm for efficient MLLM-based perception. On the one hand, it benefits autonomous driving and robotics by reducing overhead and unifying 2D and 3D perception tasks. On the other hand, it reduces the difficulty of deploying large models on the edge by significantly reducing computational overhead, and lowers the research threshold to promote innovation for MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们的DVD框架为高效的基于MLLM的认知提供了一个可概括的新范式. 一方面,通过减少间接费用和统一2D和3D感知任务,它有利于自主驾驶和机器人. 另一方面,它通过大幅降低计算间接费用来降低在边缘部署大型模型的难度,并降低研究门槛来推动MLLMs的创新.

blocks.en: However, due to its powerful perception capabilities, our research could be misused in closed-circuit television surveillance systems and affect personal privacy.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于其强大的感知能力,我们的研究可能会被滥用于闭路电视监视系统,并会影响个人隐私.
